title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 35 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 35)

content.overview: Section 35 provides that an arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties and persons claiming under them, subject to the Act's statutory remedies.

content.study:
Section 35 — Finality of arbitral awards

Section 35 provides that an arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties and persons claiming under them, subject to the Act's statutory remedies.

Apply the provision by identifying its statutory grounds, conditions, exceptions and procedural stage. Do not replace the statutory framework with generic arbitration commentary.
